package http

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	adminv1 "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1"
	adminhandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	apiv1 "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	internalapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
)

// RouterDependencies collects handlers.
type RouterDependencies struct {
	AnswerHandler                  *handlers.AnswerHandler
	StudentPositionHandler         *handlers.StudentPositionHandler
	StudentPracticeTaskHandler     *handlers.StudentPracticeTaskHandler
	StudentRuntimeHandler          *handlers.StudentRuntimeHandler
	StudentOnboardingHandler       *handlers.StudentOnboardingHandler
	StudentLearningJourneyHandler  *handlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler
	StudentCourseAssignmentHandler *handlers.StudentCourseAssignmentHandler
	DiagnosticAssessmentHandler    *handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentHandler
	HybridIntentHandler            *handlers.StudentHybridIntentHandler
	AdminReviewHandlers            adminhandlers.ReviewHandlers
	InternalHandler                *privatehandlers.Handler
	InternalToken                  string
	LearningPlannerInternalToken   string
	TeacherInternalToken           string
	PracticeTaskInternalToken      string
	LegacyPracticeWritesEnabled    bool
}

// NewRouter builds chi router with middleware.
func NewRouter(deps RouterDependencies) http.Handler {
	root := chi.NewRouter()
	if deps.StudentPracticeTaskHandler != nil {
		root.Get("/public/v1/practice-task-publications/{slug}", deps.StudentPracticeTaskHandler.GetPublicPracticeTaskPublication)
		root.Get("/public/v1/students/{studentID}/practice-task-publications", deps.StudentPracticeTaskHandler.ListPublicStudentPracticeTaskPublications)
	}

	if deps.InternalToken != "" && deps.InternalHandler != nil {
		// Internal endpoints must not require gateway auth headers.
		internalRouter := internalapi.NewRouter(
			deps.InternalHandler, deps.InternalToken, deps.LearningPlannerInternalToken, deps.TeacherInternalToken, deps.PracticeTaskInternalToken,
		)
		if deps.StudentRuntimeHandler != nil {
			internalRouter.Get("/runtime/tasks/{taskID}", deps.StudentRuntimeHandler.InternalGetRuntimeTask)
			internalRouter.Get("/runtime/lessons/{lessonID}", deps.StudentRuntimeHandler.InternalGetRuntimeLesson)
			if deps.LegacyPracticeWritesEnabled {
				internalRouter.Post("/runtime/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}/bind", deps.StudentRuntimeHandler.BindRuntimeAnswer)
				internalRouter.Post("/runtime/answers/{answerID}/finalize", deps.StudentRuntimeHandler.FinalizeRuntimeAnswer)
			} else {
				internalRouter.Post("/runtime/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}/bind", legacyPracticeRuntimeGone)
				internalRouter.Post("/runtime/answers/{answerID}/finalize", legacyPracticeRuntimeGone)
			}
		}
		root.Mount("/internal", internalRouter)
	}

	api := apiv1.NewRouter(
		deps.AnswerHandler,
		deps.StudentPositionHandler,
		deps.StudentPracticeTaskHandler,
		deps.StudentRuntimeHandler,
		deps.StudentOnboardingHandler,
		deps.StudentCourseAssignmentHandler,
		deps.LegacyPracticeWritesEnabled,
		deps.StudentLearningJourneyHandler,
	)
	apiv1.RegisterDiagnosticAssessmentRoutes(api, deps.DiagnosticAssessmentHandler)
	apiv1.RegisterHybridIntentRoutes(api, deps.HybridIntentHandler)
	apiWithAuth := chi.NewRouter()
	apiWithAuth.Use(httpmw.AuthMiddleware{}.Middleware)
	apiWithAuth.Mount("/", api)
	root.Mount("/api/v1", apiWithAuth)

	adminRouter := chi.NewRouter()
	adminRouter.Use(httpmw.AuthMiddleware{}.Middleware)
	adminv1.RegisterRoutes(adminRouter, deps.AdminReviewHandlers, deps.LegacyPracticeWritesEnabled)
	root.Mount("/admin/v1", adminRouter)

	root.NotFound(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": "not found"})
	})
	return root
}

func legacyPracticeRuntimeGone(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusGone)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
		"error": "legacy_practice_runtime_retired",
		"owner": "ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator",
	})
}
